summary: Documents can now hold a run of show with several people, a seating plan, a tap-to-call contact list, a countdown, a progress bar and a budget donut, and their check lists can be ticked off on the reader's phone.
details: A timeline entry shows its list items as a list and who it falls to; a table can right-align numbers, show a totals row and keep its first column in view while it scrolls sideways.
When Nora is sent a spreadsheet to turn into a document, she is told to rebuild it for a phone with these blocks rather than paste a wide grid.
limitations: A ticked box is kept in that one browser; two people opening the same document do not see each other's ticks.
Documents Nora has already made keep their old look until she is asked to make them again.
